Metadata.Goal: Add a codument/modeling domain modeling registry (XNL + xnl-vfs + xnl-vcs), with git-like deltas, a fractal-split lint, archive merge, docs/impl writeback, and a default-off modeling config.
Metadata.Description: Upgrade docs/modeling into a codument-managed modeling registry backed by xnl-vfs/xnl-vcs; track modeling changes as vcs branches merged at archive; nodes are XNL with a DEPA-grounded kind spectrum and minimal representations.

TaskSpace.name: add-modeling-registry
TaskSpace.Description: Phases: spec/schema, xnl integration, CLI lint, operation wiring + config, tests/validation.

TaskGroup.name: Spec and node schema
TaskGroup.Description: Define the modeling registry and delta specs plus the node schema (kind spectrum + minimal representations).

Task.name: Author codument-core behavior delta
Task.Description: Authored behavior_deltas/codument-core/delta.xml: modeling-registry, modeling-node-schema, modeling-delta-merge, modeling-fractal-split, modeling-config, modeling-docs-impl-writeback, host-git-versioned, knowledgesync-residue-removed. Applied to behaviors registry at archive.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: behavior://codument-core modeling requirements authored and validate (codument validate --strict OK)

Task.name: Write modeling-registry.md and modeling-delta.md
Task.Description: Author std/spec/modeling-registry.md and std/spec/modeling-delta.md mirroring behavior-registry.md / behavior-delta.md, grounded in xnl-vfs/xnl-vcs.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Registry spec defines codument/modeling layout, host-git versioning, node-meta, vfs working tree, ephemeral merge engine (no persisted .xnl-vcs)
Delta spec defines track branch + archive 3-way merge + base anchoring (decision A)

Task.name: Write node schema guide (kind spectrum + minimal reps)
Task.Description: Author the modeling node schema: kernel bare kinds vs shell namespaced kinds; representation forms (prose/ts/mermaid/pseudo); minimal-required per kind; namespaced ids; good/bad XNL examples; modeling references behavior://.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Kind spectrum and per-kind minimal representations documented with examples
DEPA fact_grade/single_writer required on entity nodes

TaskGroup.name: XNL integration layer
TaskGroup.Description: Integrate xnl-core/xnl-vfs/xnl-vcs into codument; load/save the modeling registry; validate node schema; depends on xnl.ts vfs-import resolver for cross-file imports.

Task.name: Add xnl-core/xnl-vfs deps + registry load/save
Task.Description: Added xnl-core@^0.1.6 + xnl-vfs@^0.1.1 deps; src/cli/modeling/registry.ts loads/saves codument/modeling working tree (plain fs + xnl-core parse/lineBlock, deterministic empty markers), indexes nodes by namespaced id, builds modeling:// URIs, skips hidden dirs, rejects duplicate ids. No persisted parallel vcs repo.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Registry round-trips to/from codument/modeling working tree (host-git versioned); no persisted parallel vcs repo (registry.test.ts 5 pass)

Task.name: Node schema validation
Task.Description: src/cli/modeling/schema.ts validates kind (kernel bare vs shell namespaced), namespaced ids, fact_grade enum, and minimal-required representations (entity: ts+fact_grade+single_writer; enum: ts; state-machine: mermaid; module: depends_on+capsule-tree; component: runtime/input/config/output).

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Validation rejects nodes missing minimal-required representations (schema.test.ts 8 pass)

Task.name: Modeling delta merge (node-level 3-way)
Task.Description: src/cli/modeling/merge.ts: node-level 3-way merge by id via xnl-core diffNodes/applyMutations; disjoint changes auto-merge (path-overlap detection); conservative default policy reports same-field/delete-modify/add-add conflicts (human) without silent overwrite; per-type policy override (ours|theirs|base). Base anchored at track create (decision A); ephemeral, no persisted vcs.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Concurrent-track 3-way merge works; conflicts reported not silently overwritten (merge.test.ts 7 pass)

TaskGroup.name: CLI fractal-split lint
TaskGroup.Description: codument modeling lint: flag oversized modeling XNL files for same-name-folder split.

Task.name: Implement modeling lint
Task.Description: src/cli/modeling/lint.ts: threshold-based (line/node count, defaults 400/8, configurable) scan of codument/modeling; reports split candidates. CLI `codument modeling lint [dir] [--max-lines N] [--max-nodes N]` wired into index.ts + help. Advisory: lint suggests, actual split is model-applied per folder-manifest.md.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Lint flags oversized files by line/node thresholds; CLI command + 5 tests pass (lint.test.ts)

TaskGroup.name: Operation wiring + config + cleanup
TaskGroup.Description: Wire track/implement/archive prompts; add config/modeling.xml (default off); writeback docs/impl; clean knowledgeSync residue.

Task.name: config/modeling.xml (default off) + gate
Task.Description: Added src/templates/codument/config/modeling.xml (+ dogfood copy) modeled on attractor-profiles.xml: enabled (default false), Registry dir, Lint thresholds, MergePolicy. src/cli/modeling/config.ts reads it (default OFF when absent/disabled); lint command reads thresholds from config. 4 config tests.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: No config or disabled → modeling skipped; config.ts defaults enabled=false (config.test.ts 4 pass)

Task.name: Wire track/implement/archive prompts
Task.Description: track.md §3.3b: gated step to draft modeling_deltas referencing behavior_deltas + record host-git base. archive.md §5.5: gated modeling 3-way merge (base materialized from host git, xnl-vfs merge, MergePolicy conflicts) + docs/impl writeback by category; pipeline overview updated. implement.md §11.0: gated note that implementation-time modeling changes go to modeling_deltas. All gated on config/modeling.xml enabled.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: track.md produces modeling_delta and records host-git merge base (gated)
archive.md merges modeling delta (3-way + policy) and writes docs/impl by category (gated)

Task.name: Clean knowledgeSync residue
Task.Description: Replaced active-gating knowledgeSync references in live templates + dogfood (model-driven-docs, implement, plan-schedule, discuss, track, docs-bootstrap, attractor-profiles comment) with docs-profile language. Intentional old→new migration-mapping notes (口径映射, archive.md targets migration) kept per spec.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: No active-gating knowledgeSync references remain; only intentional migration notes

TaskGroup.name: Tests and validation
TaskGroup.Description: Tests for registry round-trip, schema validation, 3-way merge/conflicts, lint, config gate; resource-driven promotion; run project validation.

Task.name: Add focused tests
Task.Description: 34 modeling tests: registry round-trip (5), schema validation (8), merge/conflict (7), lint thresholds (5), config gate (4), plus resource-driven end-to-end promotion (5) over test/resources/modeling-merge/case-NN/{base,ours,theirs}/ + expected.json (load -> merge -> writeback -> reload). Tests moved to sibling test/ dir; legacy plan.xml fixtures recovered to test/cli/utils/fixtures/.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests cover round-trip, schema, merge/conflict, lint, gate, resource-driven promotion (34 modeling tests pass)

Task.name: Run project validation
Task.Description: typecheck (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; full suite 97 pass / 0 fail; codument validate add-modeling-registry --strict OK. Note: `bun run lint` is a pre-existing project gap (no eslint flat config committed; eslint v10 requires eslint.config.js) — unrelated to this track.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: typecheck clean + 97 tests pass + track validates (lint pre-existing gap, out of scope)
